title: चतुःपञ्चाशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Ghatotkacha, rejoicing in his victory, attacks Karna, who with swift and varied weapons meets his illusions, and the Kaurava army scatters. In despair Karna takes up Indra's spear to end the rakshasa, and Karna is honoured by the Kurus as Indra by the Maruts.
summary.kn: ವಿಜಯದಿಂದ ಹರ್ಷಗೊಂಡ ಘಟೋತ್ಕಚ ಕರ್ಣನ ಮೇಲೆ ಎರಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಕರ್ಣ ವೇಗದ ವಿಧವಿಧ ಅಸ್ತ್ರಗಳಿಂದ ಅವನ ಮಾಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಕೌರವ ಸೈನ್ಯ ಚದುರುತ್ತದೆ. ಹತಾಶನಾದ ಕರ್ಣ ಇಂದ್ರನ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದು ರಾಕ್ಷಸನನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: विजय से हर्षित घटोत्कच कर्ण पर आक्रमण करता है, और कर्ण तीव्र विविध अस्त्रों से उसकी मायाओं का सामना करता है, कौरव सेना बिखरती है। निराश कर्ण इन्द्र की शक्ति उठाकर राक्षस का अन्त करता है।
summary.te: విజయంతో ఆనందించిన ఘటోత్కచుడు కర్ణునిపై దాడి చేస్తాడు; కర్ణుడు వేగవంతమైన వివిధ అస్త్రాలతో అతని మాయలను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు; కౌరవసేన చెదిరిపోతుంది. నిరాశలో కర్ణుడు ఇంద్రశక్తిని పట్టి రాక్షసుని అంతం చేస్తాడు.
summary.ta: வெற்றியால் மகிழ்ந்த கடோத்கசன் கர்ணனைத் தாக்க, கர்ணன் விரைவான பல அஸ்திரங்களால் அவன் மாயைகளை எதிர்க்கிறான்; கௌரவப் படை சிதறுகிறது. நம்பிக்கை இழந்த கர்ணன் இந்திரனின் சக்தியை ஏந்தி அரக்கனை முடிக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: വിജയത്തിൽ ആഹ്ലാദിക്കുന്ന ഘടോൽക്കചൻ കർണ്ണനെ ആക്രമിക്കുന്നു; വേഗമേറിയതും വൈവിധ്യമാർന്നതുമായ ആയുധങ്ങളാൽ കർണ്ണൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ മായകളെ നേരിടുന്നു, കൗരവ സേന ചിതറുന്നു. നിരാശനായ കർണ്ണൻ രാക്ഷസനെ അവസാനിപ്പിക്കാൻ ഇന്ദ്രന്റെ കുന്തമെടുക്കുന്നു; മരുത്തുകൾക്കിടയിലെ ഇന്ദ്രനെപ്പോലെ കുരുക്കൾ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ആദരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.154; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
निहत्यालायुधं रक्षः प्रहृष्टात्मा घटोत्कचः ।
ननाद विविधान्नादान्वाहिन्याः प्रमुखे स्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Having killed the rakshasa Alayudha, Ghatotkacha, exultant, stood at the front of the army and roared in many ways.

verses.text:
तस्य तं तुमुलं शब्दं श्रुत्वा कुञ्जरकम्पनम् ।
तावकानां महाराज भयमासीत्सुदारुणम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that tumultuous roar, which made elephants tremble, a most dreadful fear came over your men, great king.

verses.text:
अलायुधविषक्तं तु भैमसेनिं महाबलम् ।
दृष्ट्वा कर्णो महाबाहुः पाञ्चालान्समुपाद्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the mighty son of Bhima occupied with Alayudha, mighty-armed Karna rushed at the Panchalas.

verses.text:
दशभिर्दशभिर्बाणैर्धृष्टद्युम्नशिखण्डिनौ ।
दृढैः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैर्बिभेद नतपर्वभिः ॥

meaning.en: With ten arrows each, strong, with bent joints and loosed from a fully drawn bow, he pierced Dhrishtadyumna and Shikhandi.

verses.text:
ततः परमनाराचैर्युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ ।
सात्यकिं च रथोदारं कम्पयामास मार्गणैः ॥

meaning.en: Then with excellent iron arrows he made Yudhamanyu and Uttamauja shake, and Satyaki, the noble chariot-warrior, too.

verses.text:
तेषामभ्यस्यतां तत्र सर्वेषां सव्यदक्षिणम् ।
मण्डलान्येव चापानि व्यदृश्यन्त जनाधिप ॥

meaning.en: As they all shot, left and right, their bows were seen drawn into circles, O lord of men.

verses.text:
तेषां ज्यातलनिर्घोषो रथनेमिस्वनश्च ह ।
मेघानामिव घर्मान्ते बभूव तुमुलो निशि ॥

meaning.en: The twang of their bowstrings and slaps of palms and the rumble of chariot wheels was tumultuous in the night, like clouds at the end of summer.

verses.text:
ज्यानेमिघोषस्तनयित्नुमान्वै
धनुस्तडिन्मण्डलकेतुशृङ्गः ।
शरौघवर्षाकुलवृष्टिमांश्च
संग्राममेघः स बभूव राजन् ॥

meaning.en: That battle-cloud came to be, O king: the clash of bowstring and wheel-rim its thunder, the bows its lightning-garlands and banner-peaks, and floods of arrows its heavy rain.

verses.text:
तदुद्धतं शैल इवाप्रकम्प्यो
वर्षं महच्छैलसमानसारः ।
विध्वंसयामास रणे नरेन्द्र
वैकर्तनः शत्रुगणावमर्दी ॥

meaning.en: Karna, son of Vikartana, crusher of enemy hosts, like an unshaken mountain, destroyed in battle that violent downpour, whose force was like mountains.

verses.text:
ततोऽतुलैर्वज्रनिपातकल्पैः
शितैः शरैः काञ्चनचित्रपुङ्खैः ।
शत्रून्व्यपोहत्समरे महात्मा
वैकर्तनः पुत्रहिते रतस्ते ॥

meaning.en: Then the great-souled son of Vikartana, devoted to your son's good, drove off his enemies in the battle with incomparable sharp arrows like thunderbolts falling, their feathers gold and bright.

verses.text:
संछिन्नभिन्नध्वजिनश्च केचि-
त्केचिच्छरैरर्दितभिन्नदेहाः ।
केचिद्विसूता विहयाश्च केचि-
द्वैकर्तनेनाशु कृता बभूवुः ॥

meaning.en: Some had their banners cut down, others had their bodies torn and pierced by arrows, some were left without charioteers, some without horses, all quickly done by Karna, son of Vikartana.

verses.text:
अविन्दमानास्त्वथ शर्म संख्ये
यौधिष्ठिरं ते बलमन्वपद्यन् ।
तान्प्रेक्ष्य भग्नान्विमुखीकृतांश्च
घटोत्कचो रोषमतीव चक्रे ॥

meaning.en: Finding no refuge in the fight, they fled toward Yudhishthira's force. Seeing them broken and turned back, Ghatotkacha became exceedingly angry.

verses.text:
आस्थाय तं काञ्चनरत्नचित्रं
रथोत्तमं सिंह इवोन्ननाद ।
वैकर्तनं कर्णमुपेत्य चापि
विव्याध वज्रप्रतिमैः पृषत्कैः ॥

meaning.en: Mounting that excellent chariot, bright with gold and gems, he roared like a lion, and went up to Karna, son of Vikartana, and pierced him with arrows like thunderbolts.

verses.text:
तौ कर्णिनाराचशिलीमुखैश्च
नालीकदण्डैश्च सवत्सदन्तैः ।
वराहकर्णैः सविषाणशृङ्गैः
क्षुरप्रवर्षैश्च विनेदतुः खम् ॥

meaning.en: With karni arrows, naracha and shilimukha arrows, nalika shafts, vatsadanta, varahakarna and vishana arrows, and showers of kshurapra arrows, the two made the sky resound.

verses.text:
तद्बाणधारावृतमन्तरिक्षं
तिर्यग्गताभिः समरे रराज ।
सुवर्णपुङ्खज्वलितप्रभाभि-
र्विचित्रपुष्पाभिरिव स्रजाभिः ॥

meaning.en: The sky, covered by streams of their arrows flying slantwise in the battle, shone with their gold-feathered, glowing gleams, like garlands of many-colored flowers.

verses.text:
समं हि तावप्रतिमप्रभावा-
वन्योन्यमाजघ्नतुरुत्तमास्त्रैः ।
तयोर्हि वीरोत्तमयोर्न कश्चि-
द्ददर्श तस्मिन्समरे विशेषम् ॥

meaning.en: Equal in incomparable power, the two struck each other with the best of weapons. No one saw any difference between those two best of heroes in that fight.

verses.text:
अतीव तच्चित्रमतीव रूपं
बभूव युद्धं रविभीमसून्वोः ।
समाकुलं शस्त्रनिपातघोरं
दिवीव राह्वंशुमतोः प्रतप्तम् ॥

meaning.en: Exceedingly wondrous in form was that battle between the son of the sun and the son of Bhima, crowded and fearful with falling weapons, like Rahu and the sun in heaven locked in struggle.

verses.text:
घटोत्कचो यदा कर्णं न विशेषयते नृप ।
तदा प्रादुश्चकारोग्रमस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः ॥

meaning.en: When Ghatotkacha could not gain the upper hand over Karna, O king, that best of those who know weapons brought forth a fierce weapon.

verses.text:
तेनास्त्रेण हयान्पूर्वं हत्वा कर्णस्य राक्षसः ।
सारथिं चैव हैडिम्बः क्षिप्रमन्तरधीयत ॥

meaning.en: With that weapon the son of Hidimba first killed Karna's horses and his charioteer, and then quickly vanished.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
तथा ह्यन्तर्हिते तस्मिन्कूटयोधिनि राक्षसे ।
मामकैः प्रतिपन्नं यत्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय ॥

meaning.en: When that rakshasa who fought by trickery had thus vanished, tell me, Sanjaya, what my men did.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
अन्तर्हितं राक्षसं तं विदित्वा
संप्राक्रोशन्कुरवः सर्व एव ।
कथं नायं राक्षसः कूटयोधी
हन्यात्कर्णं समरेऽदृश्यमानः ॥

meaning.en: Knowing that the rakshasa had disappeared, all the Kurus cried out: 'How will this rakshasa, a trickster fighter, not kill Karna, unseen in the battle?'

verses.text:
ततः कर्णो लघुचित्रास्त्रयोधी
सर्वा दिशो व्यावृणोद्बाणजालैः ।
न वै किंचिद्व्यापतत्तत्र भूतं
तमोभूते सायकैरन्तरिक्षे ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna, quick and skilled with wondrous weapons, covered all directions with nets of arrows. Nothing moved in the sky, which had become darkness, because of his shafts.

verses.text:
न चाददानो न च संदधानो
न चेषुधी स्पृशमानः कराग्रैः ।
अदृश्यद्वै लाघवात्सूतपुत्रः
सर्वं बाणैश्छादयानोऽन्तरिक्षम् ॥

meaning.en: The charioteer's son was never seen taking up an arrow, fitting it, or touching his quivers with his fingertips, so swift was he, covering the whole sky with arrows.

verses.text:
ततो मायां विहितामन्तरिक्षे
घोरां भीमां दारुणां राक्षसेन ।
संपश्यामो लोहिताभ्रप्रकाशां
देदीप्यन्तीमग्निशिखामिवोग्राम् ॥

meaning.en: Then we saw in the sky an illusion made by the rakshasa, terrible, frightful and cruel, gleaming like a red cloud, blazing like a fierce tongue of fire.

verses.text:
ततस्तस्या विद्युतः प्रादुरास-
न्नुल्काश्चापि ज्वलिताः कौरवेन्द्र ।
घोषश्चान्यः प्रादुरासीत्सुघोरः
सहस्रशो नदतां दुन्दुभीनाम् ॥

meaning.en: From it came flashes of lightning and burning meteors, O Kaurava lord, and another dreadful noise arose of thousands of roaring drums.

verses.text:
ततः शराः प्रापतन्रुक्मपुङ्खाः
शक्त्यः प्रासा मुसलान्यायुधानि ।
परश्वधास्तैलधौताश्च खड्गाः
प्रदीप्ताग्राः पट्टिशास्तोमराश्च ॥

meaning.en: Then arrows with golden feathers fell, with spears, lances, pestles, weapons, axes, swords washed in oil, blazing-tipped pattishas and tomaras.

verses.text:
मयूखिनः परिघा लोहबद्धा
गदाश्चित्राः शितधाराश्च शूलाः ।
गुर्व्यो गदा हेमपट्टावनद्धाः
शतघ्न्यश्च प्रादुरासन्समन्तात् ॥

meaning.en: Shining clubs bound with iron, strange maces, sharp-edged spears, heavy maces wrapped in gold bands, and shataghnis appeared everywhere.

verses.text:
महाशिलाश्चापतंस्तत्र तत्र
सहस्रशः साशनयः सवज्राः ।
चक्राणि चानेकशतक्षुराणि
प्रादुर्बभूवुर्ज्वलनप्रभाणि ॥

meaning.en: Great boulders fell here and there by thousands, with thunderbolts and lightning, and discs with hundreds of razor-edges appeared, gleaming like fire.

verses.text:
तां शक्तिपाषाणपरश्वधानां
प्रासासिवज्राशनिमुद्गराणाम् ।
वृष्टिं विशालां ज्वलितां पतन्तीं
कर्णः शरौघैर्न शशाक हन्तुम् ॥

meaning.en: Karna could not destroy with floods of arrows that vast, blazing, falling rain of spears, stones, axes, lances, swords, thunderbolts, lightnings and hammers.

verses.text:
शराहतानां पततां हयानां
वज्राहतानां पततां गजानाम् ।
शिलाहतानां च महारथानां
महान्निनादः पततां बभूव ॥

meaning.en: A great cry arose from the horses falling struck by arrows, elephants struck by thunderbolts, and great chariot-warriors falling crushed by stones.

verses.text:
सुभीमनानाविधशस्त्रपातै-
र्घटोत्कचेनाभिहतं समन्तात् ।
दौर्योधनं तद्बलमार्तरूप-
मावर्तमानं ददृशे भ्रमन्तम् ॥

meaning.en: Struck on all sides by the fall of many kinds of dreadful weapons from Ghatotkacha, Duryodhana's army was seen in distress, whirling and wandering.

verses.text:
हाहाकृतं संपरिवर्तमानं
संलीयमानं च विषण्णरूपम् ।
ते त्वार्यभावात्पुरुषप्रवीराः
पराङ्मुखा न बभूवुस्तदानीम् ॥

meaning.en: Wailing, turning about, shrinking back and dejected, still the foremost heroes among them, out of nobility, did not turn their backs then.

verses.text:
तां राक्षसीं घोरतरां सुभीमां
वृष्टिं महाशस्त्रमयीं पतन्तीम् ।
दृष्ट्वा बलौघांश्च निपात्यमाना-
न्महद्भयं तव पुत्रान्विवेश ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that dreadful, most fearsome rakshasa rain made of great weapons falling, and the masses of troops being brought down, great fear entered your sons.

verses.text:
शिवाश्च वैश्वानरदीप्तजिह्वाः
सुभीमनादाः शतशो नदन्त्यः ।
रक्षोगणान्नर्दतश्चाभिवीक्ष्य
नरेन्द्रयोधा व्यथिता बभूवुः ॥

meaning.en: Jackals with tongues blazing like fire, howling horribly by the hundreds, and seeing the rakshasa hordes roar, the warriors of the kings were shaken.

verses.text:
ते दीप्तजिह्वाननतीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रा
विभीषणाः शैलनिकाशकायाः ।
नभोगताः शक्तिविषक्तहस्ता
मेघा व्यमुञ्चन्निव वृष्टिमार्गम् ॥

meaning.en: Those rakshasas, with flaming tongues and mouths and sharp fangs, terrifying, with bodies like mountains, sky-borne, spears in their hands, like clouds let loose a path of rain.

verses.text:
तैराहतास्ते शरशक्तिशूलै-
र्गदाभिरुग्रैः परिघैश्च दीप्तैः ।
वज्रैः पिनाकैरशनिप्रहारै-
श्चक्रैः शतघ्न्युन्मथिताश्च पेतुः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by their arrows, spears, tridents, fierce maces, blazing clubs, thunderbolts, pinakas, lightnings, discs and shataghnis, the men fell crushed.

verses.text:
हुडा भुशुण्ड्योऽश्मगुडाः शतघ्न्यः
स्थूणाश्च कार्ष्णायसपट्टनद्धाः ।
अवाकिरंस्तव पुत्रस्य सैन्यं
तथा रौद्रं कश्मलं प्रादुरासीत् ॥

meaning.en: Huda rams, bhushundis, stone balls, shataghnis, posts bound in black iron bands: they rained on your son's army, and a dreadful confusion arose.

verses.text:
निष्कीर्णान्त्रा विहतैरुत्तमाङ्गैः
संभग्नाङ्गाः शेरते तत्र शूराः ।
भिन्ना हयाः कुञ्जराश्चावभग्नाः
संचूर्णिताश्चैव रथाः शिलाभिः ॥

meaning.en: Heroes lay there, entrails spilled, heads smashed, limbs broken. Horses were split, elephants shattered, and chariots crushed by the stones.

verses.text:
एवं महच्छस्त्रवर्षं सृजन्त-
स्ते यातुधाना भुवि घोररूपाः ।
मायाः सृष्टास्तत्र घटोत्कचेन
नामुञ्चन्वै याचमानं न भीतम् ॥

meaning.en: Thus those fearsome-looking demons on the ground, loosing a great rain of weapons, the illusions made by Ghatotkacha, spared neither one who pleaded nor one who was afraid.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्घोरे कुरुवीरावमर्दे
कालोत्सृष्टे क्षत्रियाणामभावे ।
ते वै भग्नाः सहसा व्यद्रवन्त
प्राक्रोशन्तः कौरवाः सर्व एव ॥

meaning.en: In that dreadful crushing of the Kuru heroes, as if set loose by Time, with the kshatriyas passing away, they were broken and suddenly fled, all the Kauravas crying out,

verses.text:
पलायध्वं कुरवो नैतदस्ति
सेन्द्रा देवा घ्नन्ति नः पाण्डवार्थे ।
तथा तेषां मज्जतां भारतानां
न स्म द्वीपस्तत्र कश्चिद्बभूव ॥

meaning.en: 'Flee, Kurus! This cannot be fought! The gods with Indra are killing us for the Pandavas!' So, as the Bharatas were sinking, there was no island of refuge for them.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्संक्रन्दे तुमुले वर्तमाने
सैन्ये भग्ने लीयमाने कुरूणाम् ।
अनीकानां प्रविभागेऽप्रकाशे
न ज्ञायन्ते कुरवो नेतरे वा ॥

meaning.en: In that tumultuous wailing, with the Kuru army broken and hiding, and the divisions of the troops no longer distinguishable, neither Kurus nor others could be told apart.

verses.text:
निर्मर्यादे विद्रवे घोररूपे
सर्वा दिशः प्रेक्षमाणाः स्म शून्याः ।
तां शस्त्रवृष्टिमुरसा गाहमानं
कर्णं चैकं तत्र राजन्नपश्यम् ॥

meaning.en: In that fearful, unrestrained flight we saw all directions empty. And in that rain of weapons, O king, I saw only Karna, plunging into it with his chest.

verses.text:
ततो बाणैरावृणोदन्तरिक्षं
दिव्यां मायां योधयन्राक्षसस्य ।
ह्रीमान्कुर्वन्दुष्करमार्यकर्म
नैवामुह्यत्संयुगे सूतपुत्रः ॥

meaning.en: Then, fighting the rakshasa's divine illusion, he covered the sky with arrows. Modest, doing a deed hard and noble, the charioteer's son was not bewildered in the battle.

verses.text:
ततो भीताः समुदैक्षन्त कर्णं
राजन्सर्वे सैन्धवा बाह्लिकाश्च ।
असंमोहं पूजयन्तोऽस्य संख्ये
संपश्यन्तो विजयं राक्षसस्य ॥

meaning.en: Then, frightened, all the Saindhavas and Bahlikas, O king, looked toward Karna, honoring his clear-mindedness in the battle, while seeing the rakshasa's victory.

verses.text:
तेनोत्सृष्टा चक्रयुक्ता शतघ्नी
समं सर्वांश्चतुरोऽश्वाञ्जघान ।
ते जानुभिर्जगतीमन्वपद्य-
न्गतासवो निर्दशनाक्षिजिह्वाः ॥

meaning.en: A shataghni with a wheel, loosed by Ghatotkacha, killed all four of Karna's horses at once. They sank on their knees to the earth, lifeless, with teeth bared and eyes and tongues out.

verses.text:
ततो हताश्वादवरुह्य वाहा-
दन्तर्मनाः कुरुषु प्राद्रवत्सु ।
दिव्ये चास्त्रे मायया वध्यमाने
नैवामुह्यच्चिन्तयन्प्राप्तकालम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, getting down from his chariot, its horses dead, his mind steady while the Kurus fled and the divine weapon was being slain by illusion, Karna was not bewildered but considered that the time had come.

verses.text:
ततोऽब्रुवन्कुरवः सर्व एव
कर्णं दृष्ट्वा घोररूपां च मायाम् ।
शक्त्या रक्षो जहि कर्णाद्य तूर्णं
नश्यन्त्येते कुरवो धार्तराष्ट्राः ॥

meaning.en: Then all the Kurus, seeing Karna and the frightful illusion, said: 'Karna, kill the rakshasa now, quickly, with the spear! These Kurus, the Dhartarashtras, are being destroyed.

verses.text:
करिष्यतः किं च नो भीमपार्थौ
तपन्तमेनं जहि रक्षो निशीथे ।
यो नः संग्रामाद्घोररूपाद्विमुच्ये-
त्स नः पार्थान्समरे योधयेत ॥

meaning.en: 'What can Bhima and Arjuna do to us? Kill this rakshasa who is scorching us at midnight. Whoever escapes this dreadful battle can fight the sons of Pritha later.

verses.text:
तस्मादेनं राक्षसं घोररूपं
जहि शक्त्या दत्तया वासवेन ।
मा कौरवाः सर्व एवेन्द्रकल्पा
रात्रीमुखे कर्ण नेशुः सयोधाः ॥

meaning.en: 'So kill this fearsome rakshasa with the spear Indra gave you, lest all the Kauravas, equal to Indra, perish with their warriors at the start of the night, Karna.'

verses.text:
स वध्यमानो रक्षसा वै निशीथे
दृष्ट्वा राजन्नश्यमानं बलं च ।
महच्च श्रुत्वा निनदं कौरवाणां
मतिं दध्रे शक्तिमोक्षाय कर्णः ॥

meaning.en: Being struck by the rakshasa in the midnight, seeing his army perishing, and hearing the great cry of the Kauravas, Karna, O king, made up his mind to loose the spear.

verses.text:
स वै क्रुद्धः सिंह इवात्यमर्षी
नामर्षयत्प्रतिघातं रणे तम् ।
शक्तिं श्रेष्ठां वैजयन्तीमसह्यां
समाददे तस्य वधं चिकीर्षन् ॥

meaning.en: Angry like a lion and very impatient, he could not bear that assault in the battle. Wishing to kill the rakshasa, he took up the excellent spear Vaijayanti, irresistible.

verses.text:
यासौ राजन्निहिता वर्षपूगा-
न्वधायाजौ सत्कृता फल्गुनस्य ।
यां वै प्रादात्सूतपुत्राय शक्रः
शक्तिं श्रेष्ठां कुण्डलाभ्यां निमाय ॥

meaning.en: That spear, O king, which he had kept for years, honored, to kill Arjuna in battle, which Indra gave the charioteer's son in exchange for his earrings,

verses.text:
तां वै शक्तिं लेलिहानां प्रदीप्तां
पाशैर्युक्तामन्तकस्येव रात्रिम् ।
मृत्योः स्वसारं ज्वलितामिवोल्कां
वैकर्तनः प्राहिणोद्राक्षसाय ॥

meaning.en: that spear, licking its lips, blazing, bound with nooses, like the night of Death, the sister of Mrityu, like a flaming meteor, Karna, son of Vikartana, hurled at the rakshasa.

verses.text:
तामुत्तमां परकायापहन्त्रीं
दृष्ट्वा सौतेर्बाहुसंस्थां ज्वलन्तीम् ।
भीतं रक्षो विप्रदुद्राव राज-
न्कृत्वात्मानं विन्ध्यपादप्रमाणम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that supreme spear, destroyer of enemy bodies, blazing in the hand of the charioteer's son, the frightened rakshasa fled, O king, making his body as big as a Vindhya tree.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा शक्तिं कर्णबाह्वन्तरस्थां
नेदुर्भूतान्यन्तरिक्षे नरेन्द्र ।
ववुर्वातास्तुमुलाश्चापि राज-
न्सनिर्घाता चाशनिर्गां जगाम ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the spear held in Karna's arm, beings in the sky cried out, O lord of men. Fierce winds blew, O king, and a thunderbolt with a crash fell to earth.

verses.text:
सा तां मायां भस्म कृत्वा ज्वलन्ती
भित्त्वा गाढं हृदयं राक्षसस्य ।
ऊर्ध्वं ययौ दीप्यमाना निशायां
नक्षत्राणामन्तराण्याविशन्ती ॥

meaning.en: That blazing spear reduced his illusion to ashes, deeply pierced the rakshasa's heart, and flaming in the night went upward, entering among the stars.

verses.text:
युद्ध्वा चित्रैर्विविधैः शस्त्रपूगै-
र्दिव्यैर्वीरो मानुषै राक्षसैश्च ।
नदन्नादान्विविधान्भैरवांश्च
प्राणानिष्टांस्त्याजितः शक्रशक्त्या ॥

meaning.en: The hero, after fighting with many varied masses of weapons, divine, human and rakshasa, and after roaring many terrible roars, was made to give up his dear life by Indra's spear.

verses.text:
इदं चान्यच्चित्रमाश्चर्यरूपं
चकारासौ कर्म शत्रुक्षयाय ।
तस्मिन्काले शक्तिनिर्भिन्नमर्मा
बभौ राजन्मेघशैलप्रकाशः ॥

meaning.en: And he performed this other wondrous, astonishing deed to destroy his foes. At that moment, with his vitals pierced by the spear, he shone, O king, like a cloud-mountain.

verses.text:
ततोऽन्तरिक्षादपतद्गतासुः
स राक्षसेन्द्रो भुवि भिन्नदेहः ।
अवाक्शिराः स्तब्धगात्रो विजिह्वो
घटोत्कचो महदास्थाय रूपम् ॥

meaning.en: Then from the sky fell the lifeless lord of rakshasas, his body broken on the ground, head down, limbs stiff, tongue out. Ghatotkacha had taken on a vast form.

verses.text:
स तद्रूपं भैरवं भीमकर्मा
भीमं कृत्वा भैमसेनिः पपात ।
हतोऽप्येवं तव सैन्येकदेश-
मपोथयत्कौरवान्भीषयाणः ॥

meaning.en: Making that frightful form fearsome, Bhima's son, of fearful deeds, fell. Even dead, he crushed a part of your army, terrifying the Kauravas.

verses.text:
ततो मिश्राः प्राणदन्सिंहनादै-
र्भेर्यः शङ्खा मुरजाश्चानकाश्च ।
दग्धां मायां निहतं राक्षसं च
दृष्ट्वा हृष्टाः प्राणदन्कौरवेयाः ॥

meaning.en: Then, joined with lion-roars, drums, conches, mridangas and anakas sounded. Seeing the illusion burned and the rakshasa slain, the Kauravas shouted with joy.

verses.text:
ततः कर्णः कुरुभिः पूज्यमानो
यथा शक्रो वृत्रवधे मरुद्भिः ।
अन्वारूढस्तव पुत्रं रथस्थं
हृष्टश्चापि प्राविशत्स्वं स सैन्यम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna, honored by the Kurus, as Shakra was by the Maruts at Vritra's slaying, mounted and went to your son in his chariot, and joyfully entered his own army.
